```{r}
library(Seurat)
prol <- subset(all_data, Mki67 >1)
# Get all Hox genes

# Get ALL Hox genes
genes <- rownames(prol)
hox_genes <- genes[grepl("^Hox", genes, ignore.case = TRUE)]
print(hox_genes)

# Get Hox expression matrix
DefaultAssay(prol) <- "RNA"
hox_expr <- GetAssayData(prol, layer = "counts")[hox_genes, ]

# Cells where ALL Hox genes == 0 across ALL Hox genes
hox_zero_cells <- colnames(hox_expr)[Matrix::colSums(hox_expr) == 0]

# NEW subset (replace your old prol_nohox)
prol_nohox <- subset(prol, cells = hox_zero_cells)

# VERIFY ALL Hox genes now = 0
max_hox_new <- max(GetAssayData(prol_nohox, layer = "data")[hox_genes, ])
print(paste("NEW Max Hox expr:", max_hox_new))  # SHOULD BE 0!

print(paste("Hox-negative cells:", ncol(prol_nohox), "/", ncol(prol)))

prol_nohox <- subset(prol_nohox, TimePoint %in% c("E9.5", "E10.5", "E11.5","E12.5", "E13.5"))
```

```{r}
s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
# Load canonical cell cycle markers
data("cc.genes")  # Built into Seurat
s_genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m_genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
cc_genes <- unique(c(s_genes, g2m_genes))
cc_genes <- str_to_title(cc_genes)

# Check how many genes
cat("Cell cycle genes:", length(cc_genes), "\n")
cat("Found in object:", sum(cc_genes %in% rownames(RL)), "\n")


# 1. Normalize
RL <- NormalizeData(RL)

# 2. Score cell cycle FIRST (creates S.Score/G2M.Score metadata)
RL <- CellCycleScoring(RL, s.features = s_genes, g2m.features = g2m_genes)

# 3. Scale + regress cell cycle SCORES (not genes)
RL <- ScaleData(RL, vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score"))

# 4. Now PCA/clustering
RL <- RunPCA(RL, dims = 1:30)
#RL <- RunHarmony(RL, group.by = 'TimePoint', dims = 1:30)

RL <- FindNeighbors(RL,  dims = 1:30)
RL <- FindClusters(RL, resolution = 0.7)
RL <- RunUMAP(RL, dims = 1:30)
```

```{r}
# Set active ident to your new MNN clusters
Idents(RL) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.5"  # or whatever cluster column was created

# Find markers for ALL clusters
all_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  RL,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.5,
  logfc.threshold = 0.5,
  test.use = "wilcox"
)

# Top 5 markers per cluster
top_markers <- all_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC) %>%
  ungroup()


genes_use <- unique(top_markers$gene)
```

```{r}

set.seed(1)


############################################
## Shuffle options
############################################
shuffle_genes <- FALSE      # TRUE = randomize gene labels
shuffle_labels <- FALSE     # TRUE = randomize cell type labels

counts_mat <-  URL_e13_lda_sub[['RNA']]$counts
meta <- URL_e13_lda_sub@meta.data
URL_clean <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts_mat, meta.data = meta)


# Verify it worked
print(URL_e13_lda)        # Original size
print(URL_clean)    # NEW smaller size

library(Seurat)
library(glmnet)
library(dplyr)


# =============================================================================
# 1. SPLIT DATA (BEFORE FEATURE SELECTION)
# =============================================================================

cells <- colnames(URL_clean)
train_cells <- sample(cells, 0.5 * length(cells))
test_cells  <- setdiff(cells, train_cells)

train_obj <- subset(URL_clean, cells = train_cells)
test_obj  <- subset(URL_clean, cells = test_cells)

# =============================================================================
# 2. NORMALIZE + SCALE
# =============================================================================
train_obj <- NormalizeData(train_obj)
train_obj <- ScaleData(train_obj, verbose = FALSE)

test_obj <- NormalizeData(test_obj)
test_obj <- ScaleData(test_obj, verbose = FALSE)


############################################
## Shuffle options
############################################

############################################
## Shuffle metadata labels
############################################
if (shuffle_labels) {

  train_obj$branch <- sample(
    train_obj$branch
  )

  test_obj$branch <- sample(
    test_obj$branch
  )

  cat("Metadata labels shuffled\n")
}


############################################
## Shuffle gene labels
############################################
if (shuffle_genes) {

  new_names <- sample(rownames(train_obj))

  rownames(train_obj[["RNA"]]) <- new_names
  rownames(test_obj[["RNA"]])  <- new_names

  cat("Gene names shuffled\n")
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 3. FEATURE SELECTION (TRAIN ONLY)
# =============================================================================
Idents(train_obj) <- "branch"

markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  train_obj,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.6,
  logfc.threshold = 1
)

#train_features <- markers %>%
 # group_by(cluster) %>%
 # slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 100) %>%
 # pull(gene) %>%
 # unique()

# keep only scaled genes
scale_genes <- rownames(GetAssayData(train_obj, layer = "scale.data"))
train_features <- intersect(scale_genes, markers$gene) #CHANGE!!!!

cat("Training features:", length(train_features), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# 4. BUILD MATRICES
# =============================================================================
# TRAIN
train_data <- GetAssayData(train_obj, layer = "scale.data")[train_features, ]
train_matrix <- t(as.matrix(train_data))
train_labels <- as.factor(train_obj$branch)

# TEST
test_data <- GetAssayData(test_obj, layer = "scale.data")[train_features, ]
test_matrix <- t(as.matrix(test_data))
test_labels <- as.factor(test_obj$branch)

# =============================================================================
# 5. TRAIN LOGISTIC REGRESSION
# =============================================================================
fit <- cv.glmnet(
  x = train_matrix,
  y = train_labels,
  family = "multinomial",
  alpha = 0   # ridge = stable
)

cat("Model trained!\n")

# =============================================================================
# 6. EVALUATION
# =============================================================================
# Predictions
pred <- predict(fit, newx = test_matrix, s = "lambda.min", type = "class")

# Accuracy
acc <- mean(pred == test_labels)
cat("Test accuracy:", acc, "\n")

# Confusion matrix
cat("\nConfusion matrix:\n")
print(table(pred, test_labels))

# =============================================================================
# 7. PERMUTATION TEST (SIGNAL CHECK)
# =============================================================================
perm_labels <- sample(train_labels)

fit_perm <- cv.glmnet(
  x = train_matrix,
  y = perm_labels,
  family = "multinomial",
  alpha = 0
)

pred_perm <- predict(fit_perm, newx = test_matrix, s = "lambda.min", type = "class")
acc_perm <- mean(pred_perm == test_labels)

cat("Permutation accuracy:", acc_perm, "\n")

cm <- table(pred, test_labels)
cm_prop <- prop.table(cm, 2)
p <- heatmap(cm_prop)

#svg(
#  "C:/Users/kebsc/OneDrive - Johns Hopkins/Manuscripts/figs/excitatory_mouse_umaps/earlyRLprogL_confusion.svg",
#  width = 7,
#  height = 5
#)

heatmap(cm_prop)

#dev.off()

pred <- predict(fit, newx = test_matrix, s = "lambda.min", type = "response")

prob_mat <- pred[, ,1]
pred_labels <- colnames(prob_mat)[max.col(prob_mat)]
max_prob <- apply(prob_mat, 1, max)

# entropy (uncertainty)
entropy <- -rowSums(pred * log(pred + 1e-10))

# store in metadata
test_obj$predicted_fate <- pred_labels
test_obj$max_fate_prob <- max_prob
test_obj$fate_entropy <- entropy


# =============================================================================
# 8. APPLY TO RL_sub (FIXED)
# =============================================================================
RL_sub_atoh1 <- RL#subset(RL_sub, Atoh1 > 0)
RL_sub_atoh1 <- subset(
  RL_sub_atoh1,
  subset = !(Lmx1a > 0 & TimePoint == "E9.5")
)
#RL_sub_atoh1 <- subset(RL_sub_atoh1, seurat_clusters != 10)
RL_sub_atoh1 <- FindClusters(RL_sub_atoh1)
RL_sub_atoh1 <- subset(RL_sub_atoh1, seurat_clusters  != 10)
#RL_sub_atoh1 <- NormalizeData(RL_sub_atoh1)
#RL_sub_atoh1 <- ScaleData(RL_sub_atoh1)
#RL_sub_atoh1 <- RunPCA(RL_sub_atoh1, verbose = FALSE, features = train_features)
#RL_sub <- RunUMAP(RL_sub,  dims = 1:10,verbose = FALSE)

rl_scale <- GetAssayData(RL_sub_atoh1, layer = "scale.data")

# Create EMPTY matrix with all training features
query_matrix <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = ncol(rl_scale),
  ncol = length(train_features)
)

colnames(query_matrix) <- train_features
rownames(query_matrix) <- colnames(RL_sub_atoh1)

# Fill only overlapping genes
common_features <- intersect(train_features, rownames(rl_scale))

query_matrix[, common_features] <- t(as.matrix(rl_scale[common_features, ]))

# =============================================================================
# Predict
# =============================================================================
query_probs <- predict(
  fit,
  newx = query_matrix,
  s = "lambda.min",
  type = "response"
)

# =============================================================================
# 9. FATE BIAS METRICS
# =============================================================================
# max probability (commitment)
prob_mat <- query_probs[, , 1]
pred_labels <- colnames(prob_mat)[max.col(prob_mat)]
max_prob <- apply(prob_mat, 1, max)

# entropy (uncertainty)
entropy <- -rowSums(query_probs * log(query_probs + 1e-10))
# store in metadata
RL_sub_atoh1$predicted_fate <- pred_labels
RL_sub_atoh1$max_fate_prob <- max_prob
RL_sub_atoh1$fate_entropy <- entropy

cat("\nRL_sub predictions complete!\n")
```

```{r}
# Get unique cell types from test_obj (used for thresholds)
cell_types <- unique(test_obj$predicted_fate)

# Compute 90th percentile thresholds from test_obj
thresholds <- sapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
  quantile(test_obj$max_fate_prob[test_obj$predicted_fate == ct], 0.2, na.rm = TRUE)
})

# Initialize metadata for RL_sub
RL_sub_atoh1$high_fate_label <- NA  # default is NA

for (ct in names(thresholds)) {
  ct_clean <- gsub("\\.20%", "", ct)  # remove ".percent" at the end
  print(ct_clean)
  cells <- which(RL_sub_atoh1$predicted_fate == ct_clean)
  
  RL_sub_atoh1$high_fate_label[cells] <- ifelse(
    RL_sub_atoh1$max_fate_prob[cells] > thresholds[ct],
    RL_sub_atoh1$predicted_fate[cells],
    NA
  )
}

# Optional: convert to factor (NA will stay as NA)
RL_sub_atoh1$high_fate_label <- factor(RL_sub_atoh1$high_fate_label, levels = unique(RL_sub_atoh1$predicted_fate))
DimPlot(RL_sub_atoh1, group.by = "high_fate_label", pt.size = 2)
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(glmnet)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(1)

# =============================================================================
# 1. SPLIT DATA (BEFORE FEATURE SELECTION)
# =============================================================================
shuffle_genes = FALSE
shuffle_labels = FALSE

cells <- colnames(URL_clean)
train_cells <- sample(cells, 0.5 * length(cells))
test_cells  <- setdiff(cells, train_cells)

train_obj <- subset(URL_clean, cells = train_cells)
test_obj  <- subset(URL_clean, cells = test_cells)

# =============================================================================
# 2. NORMALIZE + SCALE
# =============================================================================
train_obj <- NormalizeData(train_obj)
train_obj <- ScaleData(train_obj, verbose = FALSE)

test_obj <- NormalizeData(test_obj)
test_obj <- ScaleData(test_obj, verbose = FALSE)


############################################
## Shuffle options
############################################

############################################
## Shuffle metadata labels
############################################
if (shuffle_labels) {

  train_obj$med_2p_branch_full <- sample(
    train_obj$med_2p_branch_full
  )

  test_obj$med_2p_branch_full <- sample(
    test_obj$med_2p_branch_full
  )

  cat("Metadata labels shuffled\n")
}


############################################
## Shuffle gene labels
############################################
if (shuffle_genes) {

  new_names <- sample(rownames(train_obj))

  rownames(train_obj[["RNA"]]) <- new_names
  rownames(test_obj[["RNA"]])  <- new_names

  cat("Gene names shuffled\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# 3. FEATURE SELECTION (TRAIN ONLY)
# =============================================================================
Idents(train_obj) <- "med_2p_branch_full"

markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  train_obj,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.5,
  logfc.threshold = 0.5
)

train_features <- markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 100) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  unique()
RL_sub_early <- RL_sub#subset(RL_sub, predicted_fate == "early")
# Remove Lmx1a+ cells at E9.5
RL_sub_early <- subset(
  RL_sub_early,
  subset = !(TimePoint == "E9.5" & Lmx1a > 0)
)
RL_sub_early <- NormalizeData(RL_sub_early)
RL_sub_early <- ScaleData(RL_sub_early)
RL_sub_early <- FindVariableFeatures(RL_sub_early, nfeatures = 1000)
rl_var_genes <- VariableFeatures(RL_sub)
# keep only scaled genes
scale_genes <- rownames(GetAssayData(RL_sub_early, layer = "scale.data"))
train_features <- intersect(train_features, scale_genes) #CHANGE!!!!
train_features <- intersect(train_features, rl_var_genes) #CHANGE!!!!
#train_features <- train_features[train_features != "Pax6"]
#train_features <- c("Nr2f2", "Nr2f1", "Lmx1a", "Pax5", "Zfhx3", "Nfia", "Nfib", "En1", "En2")
cat("Training features:", length(train_features), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# 4. BUILD MATRICES
# =============================================================================
# TRAIN
train_data <- GetAssayData(train_obj, layer = "scale.data")[train_features, ]
train_matrix <- t(as.matrix(train_data))
train_labels <- as.factor(train_obj$med_2p_branch_full)

# TEST
test_data <- GetAssayData(test_obj, layer = "scale.data")[train_features, ]
test_matrix <- t(as.matrix(test_data))
test_labels <- as.factor(test_obj$med_2p_branch_full)

# =============================================================================
# 5. TRAIN LOGISTIC REGRESSION
# =============================================================================
fit <- cv.glmnet(
  x = train_matrix,
  y = train_labels,
  family = "multinomial",
  alpha = 1   # ridge = stable
)

cat("Model trained!\n")

# =============================================================================
# 6. EVALUATION
# =============================================================================
# Predictions
pred <- predict(fit, newx = test_matrix, s = "lambda.min", type = "class")

# Accuracy
acc <- mean(pred == test_labels)
cat("Test accuracy:", acc, "\n")

# Confusion matrix
cat("\nConfusion matrix:\n")
print(table(pred, test_labels))

# =============================================================================
# 7. PERMUTATION TEST (SIGNAL CHECK)
# =============================================================================
perm_labels <- sample(train_labels)

#fit_perm <- cv.glmnet(
#  x = train_matrix,
#  y = perm_labels,
#  family = "multinomial",
#  alpha = 0
#)

cm <- table(pred, test_labels)
cm_prop <- prop.table(cm, 2)
heatmap(cm_prop)


#svg(
#  "C:/Users/kebsc/OneDrive - Johns Hopkins/Manuscripts/figs/excitatory_mouse_umaps/earlyRLprog_confusion_CN.svg",
#  width = 7,
#  height = 5
#)

heatmap(cm_prop)

#dev.off()


pred <- predict(fit, newx = test_matrix, s = "lambda.min", type = "response")

prob_mat <- pred[, ,1]
pred_labels <- colnames(prob_mat)[max.col(prob_mat)]
max_prob <- apply(prob_mat, 1, max)

# entropy (uncertainty)
entropy <- -rowSums(pred * log(pred + 1e-10))

# store in metadata
test_obj$predicted_fate <- pred_labels
test_obj$max_fate_prob <- max_prob
test_obj$fate_entropy <- entropy
```

```{r}
# 1. Subset early cells
RL_sub_early <- subset(RL_sub_atoh1, predicted_fate == "early")
RL_sub_early <- subset(RL_sub_early, max_fate_prob>0.7)
RL_sub_early = subset(RL_sub_early, TimePoint != "E13.5")

# 2. Normalize
RL_sub_early <- NormalizeData(RL_sub_early)

# """
# # 3. Load cell cycle genes
# cc.genes <- Seurat::cc.genes.updated.2019
# capitalize_first <- function(x) {
#   paste0(toupper(substr(x, 1, 1)), tolower(substr(x, 2, nchar(x))))
# }
# cc.genes <- Seurat::cc.genes.updated.2019
# 
# s.genes <- capitalize_first(cc.genes$s.genes)
# g2m.genes <- capitalize_first(cc.genes$g2m.genes)
# # Optional: match gene names to your dataset

# g2m.genes <- intersect(g2m.genes, rownames(RL_sub_early))
# 
# # 4. Score cell cycle
# RL_sub_early <- CellCycleScoring(
#   RL_sub_early,
#   s.features = s.genes,
#   g2m.features = g2m.genes,
#   set.ident = FALSE
# )
# """

# 5. Regress out cell cycle during scaling
RL_sub_early <- ScaleData(
  RL_sub_early,
  verbose = FALSE
)

# 6. Continue pipeline
RL_sub_early <- RunPCA(RL_sub_early,  features = train_features, verbose = FALSE)
RL_sub_early <- RunUMAP(RL_sub_early, dims = 1:5, verbose = FALSE)
query_matrix <- t(as.matrix(GetAssayData(RL_sub_early, layer = "scale.data")[train_features, ]))

# =============================================================================
# Predict
# =============================================================================
query_probs <- predict(
  fit,
  newx = query_matrix,
  s = "lambda.min",
  type = "response"
)

# =============================================================================
# 9. FATE BIAS METRICS
# =============================================================================
# max probability (commitment)
prob_mat <- query_probs[, , 1]
pred_labels <- colnames(prob_mat)[max.col(prob_mat)]
max_prob <- apply(prob_mat, 1, max)

# entropy (uncertainty)
entropy <- -rowSums(query_probs * log(query_probs + 1e-10))

# store in metadata
RL_sub_early$predicted_fate <- pred_labels
RL_sub_early$max_fate_prob <- max_prob
RL_sub_early$fate_entropy <- entropy
cat("\nRL_sub predictions complete!\n")
DimPlot(RL_sub_early, group.by = "predicted_fate", shuffle = TRUE, pt.size = 2)
FeaturePlot(RL_sub_early, feature = "fate_entropy", pt.size = 2)
```

```{r}
  "Early Medial",

))

  RL_sub_early$predicted_fate,
  levels = desired_order
```

```{r}
####### MIX LABELS BUT USE ORIGINAL GENE SET ###########

real_stat <- mean(max_prob)   # simplest + robust

n_perm <- 100
perm_stats <- numeric(n_perm)

for (i in 1:n_perm) {

  perm_labels <- sample(train_labels)

  fit_perm <- cv.glmnet(
    x = train_matrix,
    y = perm_labels,
    family = "multinomial",
    alpha = 1
  )

  perm_probs <- predict(
    fit_perm,
    newx = query_matrix,
    s = "lambda.min",
    type = "response"
  )

  perm_prob_mat <- drop(perm_probs[,,1])
  perm_max <- apply(perm_prob_mat, 1, max)

  perm_stats[i] <- mean(perm_max)

  cat("perm", i, "\n")
}
```

```{r}
####### MIX LABELS BUT AND CHANGE GENE SET ###########

real_stat <- mean(max_prob)   # simplest + robust

n_perm <- 100
perm_stats <- numeric(n_perm)

for (i in 1:n_perm) {
  perm_labels <- sample(train_obj$med_2p_branch_full)
  train_obj$perm_label <- perm_labels
  Idents(train_obj) <- "perm_label"

  markers <- FindAllMarkers(
    train_obj,
    only.pos = TRUE,
    min.pct = 0.25,
    logfc.threshold = 0.25
  )
  
  train_features <- markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 100) %>%
    pull(gene) %>%
    unique()
  print(train_features)
  # keep only scaled genes
  scale_genes <- rownames(GetAssayData(train_obj, layer = "scale.data"))
  train_features <- intersect(train_features, scale_genes) #CHANGE!!!!
  train_features <- intersect(train_features, rl_var_genes) #CHANGE!!!!
  #train_features <- train_features[train_features != "Pax6"]
  
  #train_features <- c("Nr2f2", "Nr2f1", "Lmx1a", "Pax5", "Zfhx3", "Nfia", "Nfib")
  cat("Training features:", length(train_features), "\n")
  
  # =============================================================================
  # 4. BUILD MATRICES
  # =============================================================================
  # TRAIN
  train_data <- GetAssayData(train_obj, layer = "scale.data")[train_features, ]
  train_matrix <- t(as.matrix(train_data))
  train_labels <- as.factor(train_obj$perm_label)
  
  
  # =============================================================================
  # 5. TRAIN LOGISTIC REGRESSION
  # =============================================================================
  fit_perm <- cv.glmnet(
    x = train_matrix,
    y = perm_labels,
    family = "multinomial",
    alpha = 1   # ridge = stable
  )
  perm_probs <- predict(
    fit_perm,
    newx = query_matrix,
    s = "lambda.min",
    type = "response"
  )

  perm_prob_mat <- drop(perm_probs[,,1])
  perm_max <- apply(perm_prob_mat, 1, max)

  perm_stats[i] <- mean(perm_max)

  cat("perm", i, "\n")
}

pval <- mean(perm_stats >= real_stat)
```

```{r}
# real stats
prob_mat <- drop(query_probs[,,1])

real_high <- mean(max_prob > 0.7)

coefs <- coef(fit, s = "lambda.min")

get_top_abs <- function(coef_vec, n = 20) {
  coef_vec <- as.numeric(coef_vec)
  names(coef_vec) <- rownames(coefs[[1]])
  coef_vec <- coef_vec[-1]
  names(sort(abs(coef_vec), decreasing = TRUE)[1:n])
}

# top genes per class
top_genes_list <- lapply(coefs, get_top_abs, n = 50)

# union of all
top_genes <- unique(unlist(top_genes_list))


permute_selected_genes <- function(mat, genes) {
  mat_perm <- mat
  idx <- which(colnames(mat) %in% genes)
  for (j in idx) {
    mat_perm[, j] <- sample(mat[, j])
  }
  mat_perm
}

n_perm <- 100
perm_target_stats <- numeric(n_perm)

for (i in 1:n_perm) {


  ###### 3. TARGETED GENE PERMUTATION ######
  query_perm <- permute_selected_genes(query_matrix, top_genes)

  probs <- predict(fit, newx = query_perm, s = "lambda.min", type = "response")
  pm <- drop(probs[,,1])
  perm_target_stats[i] <- mean(apply(pm, 1, max))


  cat("perm", i, "\n")
}

p_target <- mean(perm_target_stats >= real_mean)



hist(perm_target_stats,
     #breaks = 30,
     col = rgb(0,1,0,0.3), xlim = c(0.4,0.8),
     main = "Permuting explanatory genes in query data",
     xlab = "Average probability",
     ylab = "Frequency")

abline(v = real_mean, col = "red", lwd = 3)
```
